# Draft:League of Legends: Swarm

The League of Legends “Swarm” mode is a limited-time PvE (Player vs. Environment) game mode introduced as part of the Anima Squad event. In Swarm, players team up in groups of up to four to combat waves of alien enemies called Primordians. This mode breaks away from the traditional League setup by adopting WASD controls for movement and a different aim system, which enhances the roguelite-like experience. Players choose from a roster of champions and battle through multiple maps, each culminating in a boss fight. Swarm also features a progression system where players can upgrade their abilities and weapons as they advance, adding a fresh layer of strategy to the PvE genre within League of Legends
